title: The French assembly adopts a declaration of rights
summary: The French National Assembly voted on the articles of the Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen during 20–26 August 1789.

citations.note: Supports the factual summary and chronology. Context includes explicitly interpretive comparisons; the date note identifies limits of precision.

claims.text: The French National Assembly voted on the articles of the Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen during 20–26 August 1789.
Voting sequence across several days, not one instant.
The declaration articulated principles of political and civil rights. Its words should not be mistaken for immediate, equal enjoyment of those rights by every inhabitant.
